TMJ Treatment at Clearwater, FL

BOOK NOW

TMJ Treatment For Improper Jaw Alignment

The Temporomandibular (TMJ) Joints are responsible for the movement of your jaw. TMJ muscles can become inflamed or sore due to damage or overuse, just like any other muscle in the body. This may lead to Temporomandibular joint disorders (TMD). TMD symptoms can include neck pain, jaw pain, clicking/popping noises, grinding noises, frequent headaches, difficulty opening/closing the jaw, and often associated earache.


Clearwater Dentist offers effective TMJ treatment to improve dental health and overall quality of living. We use advanced procedures to realign and adjust the temporomandibular joint. Before beginning treatment, we perform a thorough examination of your head, neck, and mouth to assess symptoms accurately and determine optimal jaw placement.


Our TMJ treatments involve minimally invasive procedures that focus on relieving headaches and jaw pain and restoring normal oral function. We strive to improve dental health and overall wellbeing with our personalized approach. Make an appointment for TMJ treatment now in Clearwater, FL.


TMJ disorders have a significant impact on your life. They can cause pain, discomfort and make it difficult to do simple things like eating or talking. To prevent further complications, and to improve your quality-of-life, it's crucial to address this issue as soon as possible. Clearwater Dentist provides comprehensive TMJ treatment that targets the root cause of your symptoms. You will receive relief and have optimal jaw function.


Our experienced team will develop a plan that is tailored to meet your needs during your TMJ treatment. Our advanced technologies and techniques are used to realign and adjust the temporomandibular joint, relieving pain and restoring normal jaw movement. We want to provide you with lasting relief, improve your dental health and allow you to live a life without TMJ-related pain.


Clearwater Dentist can provide effective treatment if you are experiencing TMJ symptoms, including jaw pain, headaches or difficulty opening or closing your jaw. Our team of compassionate professionals is dedicated to helping you achieve comfort and function in your everyday life. Make an appointment to begin your journey toward TMJ relief and better oral health.

Our TMJ Treatment Options

Nightguard:

A Nightguard, also known as an oral appliance, is a specially-made device that's worn at night. Its main purpose is to correct the jaw position to avoid grinding and clenching while sleeping, which can cause discomfort and dental problems. A Nightguard provides a barrier between the upper and lower teeth to reduce pressure and strain from nocturnal grinding of teeth. This device not only protects teeth but also improves sleep by reducing grinding noises.


Invisalign:

Invisalign, an innovative orthodontic treatment, uses a series transparent aligners that gradually shift your teeth to the correct alignment. Invisalign aligners, unlike traditional braces are virtually indiscernible and can be removed easily for eating, drinking and oral hygiene. This treatment improves your smile and corrects any bite problems, which can reduce symptoms of TMJ disorders. Invisalign aligns your teeth correctly, which helps reduce jaw strain. It also improves overall dental health.


Botox:

Botox injections in the jaw muscles can be used as a non-surgical option to treat TMJ disorders. The injections temporarily limit the movement of the jaw muscles and reduce overuse, resulting in relaxation and healing for TMJ issues. Botox is a great way to reduce the pain and tension in the jaw muscles, as well as headaches and facial tension, which are caused by TMJ disorders. Patients can enjoy a better quality of life and relief from their TMJ symptoms. This is a great option for those who have severe TMJ symptoms and haven't responded to other treatments.


Behavioral Modification

﻿The behavioral modification process involves a series facial and tongue exercises that are designed to realign and train the jaw in its ideal position. When performed regularly under professional supervision, these exercises can reduce TMJ symptoms through improved jaw function and reduced muscle tension. In addition to other therapeutic interventions, behavioral modification techniques are frequently incorporated into comprehensive TMJ treatments plans. By addressing underlying muscle imbalances and promoting correct jaw alignment, behavioral modifications can help to relieve TMJ-related pain and dysfunction.

Minimally Invasive

Behavioral Therapy Services

As part of our TMJ treatment, Clearwater Dentist offers cutting-edge myofunctional and orofacial therapy. This therapy is a minimally invasive way to address TMJ issues and relieve jaw pain. Rest posture therapy is a key component of orofacial therapy and myofunctional treatment. It focuses on helping patients understand and achieve their optimal jaw muscle resting position for maximum comfort.


﻿Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya will guide you in the process of retraining jaw muscles. She is an experienced dentist who can personalize therapy sessions for you. We aim to reduce TMJ symptoms by teaching the correct muscle resting posture and using muscle relaxants as needed.


Our minimally invasive TMJ treatment allows our patients to continue their daily routines without interference. Orofacial, myofunctional and behavioral therapy combined with behavioral modifications techniques offer a holistic solution to TMJ issues and promote optimal oral health.


Our behavioral therapy services can be helpful if you are experiencing TMJ symptoms like jaw pain, clicking/popping noises, or difficulty opening/closing the jaw. Call Clearwater Dentist to set up a consultation today and learn how we can alleviate TMJ symptoms, and improve your quality of life.


Why Choose Clearwater Dentist for Your TMJ Needs?

  • Expertise in TMJ Disorders

    Dr. Nadia brings extensive expertise and experience in diagnosing and treating TMJ disorders. With advanced training and a deep understanding of the complexities of the temporomandibular joint, she is equipped to provide accurate diagnoses and effective treatment strategies tailored to each patient's condition.


  • Comprehensive Evaluation

    Our approach begins with a thorough evaluation of your TMJ symptoms and oral health history. Dr. Nadia will conduct a comprehensive examination, including assessing jaw movement, muscle function, and bite alignment, to identify the underlying causes of your TMJ issues.


  • Customized Treatment Plans

    Based on the evaluation's findings, Dr. Nadia will develop a personalized treatment plan designed to address your specific TMJ needs. This plan may include a combination of conservative treatments such as lifestyle modifications, stress management techniques, and physical therapy, as well as advanced interventions like oral appliances or splints.


  • State-of-the-Art Technology

    Clearwater Dentist is equipped with state-of-the-art technology to aid in diagnosing and treating TMJ disorders. From digital imaging to computerized bite analysis, we utilize advanced tools to ensure accurate assessments and optimal treatment outcomes.

  • Holistic Approach to Care

    We take a holistic approach to TMJ treatment, considering the physical symptoms and the impact of stress, lifestyle factors, and overall well-being on your condition. Dr. Nadia works closely with each patient to address all aspects of their TMJ issues and develop comprehensive solutions for long-term relief.

  • Patient Centered Care

    At Clearwater Dentist, we prioritize patient comfort and satisfaction above all else. Our friendly and compassionate team is dedicated to providing personalized care and support throughout your TMJ treatment journey, ensuring that you feel heard, valued, and well cared for every step of the way.

  • Positive Environment

    Our modern and welcoming dental office provides a comfortable and stress-free environment for patients receiving TMJ treatment. From the moment you walk through our doors, you'll be greeted with warmth and professionalism, making your experience with us as pleasant and relaxing as possible.

  • Continued Support and Follow-Up

    We believe in providing ongoing support and follow-up care to ensure the success of your TMJ treatment. Dr. Nadia will schedule regular appointments to monitor your progress, make any necessary adjustments to your treatment plan, and address any concerns or questions you may have along the way.
